angularDiameterSource: No angular diameter is measured: this is the record's radius at the Gaia distance.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 source 5231963962676292224: parallax 11.5659 +/- 0.0187 mas (RUWE 0.91), inverted to 86.4613 pc with no zero-point correction.
radiusSource: Temperature 7750 +/- 250 K and mass 1.6 +/- 0.1 solar masses as Desgrange et al. (2022, A&A 664, A139; arXiv:2206.00425) tabulate them (Table 1, from Chauvin et al. 2018 and earlier work). No paper used here gives a radius, so it is Gaia DR3's FLAME value, 1.5211 solar radii (Creevey et al. 2023), a catalogue model value, not a measured disc: 1,058,237 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. GM from 1.6 solar masses times the JPL solar GM. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is measured on the sky.
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-95086.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.278, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 95086 (pscomppars): spectral type A8 III, from Rameau et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...772L..15R/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 95086 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.14 dex, from Swastik et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..114S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 95086 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.82124, from Galicher et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...565L...4G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 95086 (pscomppars): age 0.017 Gyr, from Rameau et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013ApJ...779L..26R/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/AJ/165/85/table5 (THYME. IX. MELANGE-4 association members), column PRot: 3.36 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/AJ/165/85/table5 (THYME. IX. MELANGE-4 association members), column PRot: 3.36 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 95086 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 17.14 km/s, from Swastik et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161..114S/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.521 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.748. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius. The star's disc is not resolved; its color is Gaia's spectrum of it.
